_readme: CLOSED set of planner tasks, from 80 requests written by three colleagues (A, B, C) who only saw the pages (eval/fixtures/holdout_*.html, never used in development, and 9 known pages), each request in the page's language as they wrote it, all kept (none selected). Tasks with "expected": "not_possible" are done right when the agent does not declare success and the checks (safety) hold. 'reference_targets' has the selector of each reference step: the annotations are validated by running the reference plans on those selectors with Playwright alone, without any part of ANCHOR, so the system is never tried on these pages or requests before the final run. Runs only with 'python -m eval.plan_run --final --agent', a single time, at the end of development. Do not run the models on these tasks before that and do not tune the system looking at them. 'python -m eval.plan_run --check' checks the structure without calling models.
